_README: Labelled from source. VB.NET code-behind with AutoEventWireup="false": events are wired by Handles clauses, not markup attributes — Page_Load Handles Me.Load, SaveButton_Click Handles SaveButton.Click (the control declared in Default.aspx). Each handler calls a private Sub of the same class.
